# explore-hub

A [Claude Code skill](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/skills) for querying a locally-cloned [hubverse](https://hubverse.io/) hub. Ask questions about submission history, team participation, forecast coverage, and more - answered in plain English.

**Note:** This is a prototype. Answers are generated by an LLM that reads hub data, so they may be incomplete or incorrect — always verify against the hub directly for anything consequential.

## Prerequisites

- [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) installed
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) installed (`brew install uv` or see uv docs)
- Python 3.12+
- A locally-cloned hubverse hub (e.g. `git clone https://github.com/reichlab/covid19-forecast-hub`)

## Usage

```
/explore-hub <path-to-hub> <question>
```

Examples:

```
/explore-hub /path/to/repos/covid19-forecast-hub Who submitted forecasts this season?
/explore-hub /path/to/repos/flu-metrocast Which teams are forecasting every location?
/explore-hub /path/to/repos/covid19-forecast-hub Does UMass submit quantile forecasts?
```

If you omit the question, the skill will confirm the hub and prompt you.

## Supported question types

- **Submission & participation** - which teams/models submitted for a given round or season
- **Historical participation** - season-over-season and year-over-year team and submission counts
- **Coverage & targets** - which teams forecast every location, target, or horizon
- **Output types** - whether a team submits quantile, point, sample, etc. forecasts
- **Forecast values** - what models predict for specific locations, targets, or horizons
- **Cross-model comparison** - how forecasts compare across models (uncertainty spread, ensemble vs. individual, optimistic vs. pessimistic)

## Feedback

Found a bug or have a question? [Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/hubverse-org/hubverse-claude-skills/issues).
